OOP ROUTING INDEX (derived from reviewed module semantics; guidance, not authority)
- core [information,interaction]: Always applies: precedence, authority, proportional G0-G4 governance, language, evidence and continuity invariants for every request and effect.
- workspace [workspace_identity,workspace_switch,private_write]: Before reading or writing private state, or when the project or working directory changes: establish project identity, private layout and runtime isolation.
- shared-context [shared_context]: Sharing hints, messages, leases, coordination entries or runtime instructions with other runtimes of the project: use attributable, conflict-safe records.
- activation [activation,full_install]: Opening a bound workspace or repairing the thin activation adapter: rediscover the binding and run the current entry contract without copied rules.
- capabilities [capability_change,full_install,installed_probe]: Installing, reusing or changing enforcement hooks, adapters or native controls: follow the frozen administrative installation and adapter rules.
- cost [facility_selection,paid_dependency]: Choosing a tool, service, dependency or any action with a monetary or quota cost: prefer adequate free/local options and justify paid ones.
- repository [repository_access,repository_create,git_commit,git_publish]: Discovering, creating, binding or writing a repository, or committing and pushing: resolve provider-neutral scoped access before effects.
- security [identity_sensitive,credential_change,sensitive_effect,git_commit,git_publish]: Credentials, identities, signing, access rights, or commits and publications carrying an identity: use project-authorized identity and separate proofs.
- model [organizational_model]: Representing organizational entities, sources of record or dependencies: keep one canonical English representation with external references.
- operations [canonical_read,canonical_write,full_install]: Reading or writing the canonical operations repository, foundational intake or publication of organizational records.
- inventory [inventory_change]: Listing, retrieving or updating the inventory of relevant repositories and resources of the organization.
- intake [request_intake,scope_uncertainty]: A request whose meaning, scope or level is uncertain: discover effective scope and ask proportionate clarification before effects.
- impact [managed_change,scope_expansion,organizational_evolution,organizational_model]: Work whose consequences may spread to other components, domains or capabilities: determine effective scope and propagate proportionately.
- tickets [ticket_mutation,durable_work,managed_change]: Work needing durable continuity or managed governance (typically G2+): open or attach a ticket or equivalent item before effects; report each transition.
- changes [change_set,managed_change]: A change to source, configuration or content that must be reviewed and verified: define the change set, apply it, verify it against effective scope.
- coordination [managed_change,change_set,semantic_propagation]: Planning or executing work affecting several organizational functions: coordinate only materially involved roles, without inferred authority.
- execution [material_effect,verification,retry,external_effect,git_commit,git_publish]: Performing any material effect, retry or verification: track intended, attempted, observed, applied and verified effects separately.
- migration [version_sensitive,organizational_migration,due_update]: Transforming shared organizational data or changing read/write compatibility: plan ownership, concurrency and verification of the migration.
- migration-distribution [due_update,adoption_change,technical_migration]: Adopting a newer OOP distribution carrying technical migrations: apply the three-scope descriptors in order, without assuming ancestry.
- adoption [due_update,adoption_change,full_install]: An OOP update is available or due: check freshness, compatibility and authorization, then adopt independently per runtime.
- continuity [continuity_reserve,handoff]: Context or compute budget is running low, or work may be interrupted: keep the reserve and prepare destination-independent continuation.
- handoff [handoff]: Transferring work to another runtime, model, person or session: prepare a portable baseline and evidence each handoff phase separately.
- destination [destination_entry]: Starting work received through a handoff: perform independent intake, filter resources and keep the source/target firewall.
- secret-transfer [secret_transfer]: A secret must reach another runtime or person: reuse existing access first and transfer separately only when necessary and authorized.
- recovery [context_loss,interrupted_setup,recovery]: Resuming after interruption, crash or context loss: reconstruct verified context and actual effects before continuing.
- decisions [decision_record]: A significant decision is made or must be recalled: record it durably with rationale and related work.
- human [human_dependency]: Progress depends on an action or decision only a human can provide: state the exact dependency and resume automatically once verified.
- physical [physical_effect]: Work with physical-world responsibilities, constraints or safety: plan observable completion and accountable owners.
- ci [change_set,semantic_propagation]: Checking consistency of a change set across dependencies before delivery: run proportionate checks and semantic compilation.
- delivery [deployment,external_effect,compensation,drift]: Deploying or applying an approved change to a controlled environment or external system: apply gates, compensation and drift handling.
- history [history_query,material_event]: Reconstructing what happened and why, or recording a material event: keep causal, non-fabricated history and reuse evidence.
- interfaces [external_interface]: Exposing organizational state to external tools or formats: project canonical English state without creating a second source of truth.
- context [context_loss,route_change,interaction]: Every interaction and before governed effects: keep the needed closure loaded, rehydrate stale context and follow runtime guidance and declaration (R27).
- entry [interaction,information]: Start of each conversation and each user message: pass the entry and interaction gates, resolve language and load minimum context.
- bootstrap [full_install,interrupted_setup]: Explicit OOP installation or interrupted setup: run the listed BOOT steps with stable identities, scoped attestation and user communication.
- delegation [delegation]: Delegating work to a sub-agent or delegate runtime: apply the same contract, owned controls and validated completion.
